title: Sit in stillness
line: A lamp, your breath and a few minutes of quiet. Nothing to believe, nothing to fix.
intro: Every tradition keeps a silence at its centre. This practice keeps only that: a small light, a slow breath and a quiet mind, with one line of comfort at the end that has helped people of every faith and none.

steps.title: Light a lamp
steps.text: A candle, a diya, or simply the light on your screen.

steps.title: Settle
steps.text: Breathe slowly. When thoughts come, let them pass like traffic outside a window.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Sit for as long as you like. If a thought keeps returning, you can set it down here.
steps.prompt: What keeps returning, and can it wait until tomorrow?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Words given to Julian of Norwich in 1373, said by many who share none of her faith.

after: Stillness is always there underneath. You can return to it.
